scientific_integrity: Proof given with full hypotheses, target boundaries and global two-predecessor count; exact symbolic checker and independent numerical quadrature reproduced. Computations support but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one-step inverse geometry on the strictly positive quadrant for d/b>1. Does not establish multi-step positivity, persistence or attractor properties. Formula is coordinate-area-dependent. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: Cubic onset of the positive-observation region in an immigrating predator–prey map
